import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter


def escape_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_cover_pdf(path, title, date_str):
    """Build a minimal one-page letter-size PDF containing centered title + date."""
    title_esc = escape_pdf_string(title)
    date_esc = escape_pdf_string(date_str)

    # Approximate Helvetica text widths (0.5 em per char) to center text.
    x_title = (612 - 0.5 * 28 * len(title)) / 2
    x_date = (612 - 0.5 * 14 * len(date_str)) / 2

    content = (
        f"BT /F1 28 Tf {x_title:.1f} 470 Td ({title_esc}) Tj ET\n"
        f"BT /F1 14 Tf {x_date:.1f} 430 Td ({date_esc}) Tj ET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(content) + content + b"endstream",
    ]

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode()
        out += obj + b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    n = len(objects) + 1
    out += f"xref\n0 {n}\n".encode()
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    out += (f"trailer\n<< /Size {n} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
            f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n").encode()

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(bytes(out))


def main():
    title = "Annual Financial Report"
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print("Cover date:", date_str)

    build_cover_pdf("cover.pdf", title, date_str)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(PdfReader("cover.pdf").pages[0])
    for page in PdfReader("report.pdf").pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open("report_with_cover.pdf", "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    # Verify the result.
    reader = PdfReader("report_with_cover.pdf")
    print("Pages in final PDF:", len(reader.pages))
    print("Page 1 text:", repr(reader.pages[0].extract_text()))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
